title: A theoretical study for aircraft handling qualities on unsteady flight conditions.
author: Felipe Bastos Gurgel Silva
abstract: The main proposal of the present work is to study aircraft handling qualities criteria for unsteady flight conditions. Firstly the idea and motivation for this study are developed by describing the importance of this topic for the aeronautical and aerospace industry. Following the sequence the work concerns on studying existing flying qualities criteria on both time and frequency domain, especially the C-star criterion which is widely used for ensure good flying qualities in aircraft design. Numerical results for the C-star criterion related to two different aircrafts were simulated assuming complete and simplified mathematical approaches and also analyzing the effect on a Stability Augmentation System on their dynamics. The analysis also involves the understanding of aircraft longitudinal dynamics due to a perturbation on its longitudinal control.
